messages:
eve: Customer on our managed plan reports intermittent 401s + long timeouts from the Go embeddings SDK when sending batched requests. Occurs ~1/50 calls. Also saw a 'dimension mismatch' error in one run. Sharing logs and repro below.

jamie: Thanks — can you paste the exact SDK call, headers, and whether you have client-side retries enabled? Also your embedding dimension and batch size.

eve: Repro snippet (Go):
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
defer cancel()
req := &redwood.EmbeddingsRequest{
  Model: "rw-emb-small",
  Inputs: [][]float32{{...}}, // sending 8 texts at once
  BatchSize: 8,
}
res, err := client.Embeddings.Batch(ctx, req)
if err != nil {
  log.Println("embed err:", err)
}
```
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <rotating-token>, Content-Type: application/json
Dim: 512, batch:8

Logs: 
```
2026-03-17T14:12:01Z api: POST /v1/embeddings 401 unauthorized token_expired
2026-03-17T14:12:01Z sdk-go: retrying request (attempt 2)
2026-03-17T14:12:02Z api: POST /v1/embeddings 200 ok (but body had "dimension mismatch: expected 512, got 256")
2026-03-17T14:12:03Z sdk-go: request timed out after 10s
```

lina: Hmm. Two things to triage: 1) token rotation/refresh under concurrent requests + retries could surface 401s. 2) the dimension mismatch showing a 256 result hints at a corrupted batch aggregator feeding the wrong model variant when retries happen. @andrew can you check model/router logs for that time window?

andrew: Checking infra logs — showed a burst of 401s originating from the client's IP and the auth-gateway returned token_expired for several concurrent inflight requests. We also see the routing layer send the second attempt to a quantized model variant (256-dim) due to a transient model-selection fallback when the primary pool returned slow. So two separate issues aligned: stale token + model fallback.

jamie: eve, can you confirm if your app reuses a single token for many goroutines? Also are you using the SDK's default retry/backoff? If yes, try disabling automatic retries temporarily.

eve: We were using a single rotating token stored in a global var and the SDK default retry. Disabled retries locally and rotating the token more eagerly. After that, 401s dropped to near zero and I didn't see the dim-mismatch in the quick test.

lina: Thanks — we found a race in the Go SDK batcher: when a request is retried and the batcher hasn't cleared its aggregation state, a partial aggregation could be sent to an alternate model variant if routing fails. Patch summary: ensure per-request batch context and clear aggregator on retry; also force token refresh on 401 before retry.

deploy-bot: Deployed sdk-go@v0.9.3-canary to canary=10% at 2026-03-17T15:02:00Z :rocket:

lina: Can you test the canary build? Install with:
```
go get github.com/redwood/sdk-go@v0.9.3-canary
```
and run your same workload for a few hours. If stable, we’ll promote to stable.

eve: Installing now. For reference, the failing run was 512-dim embeddings, batch size 8, about 150 rps bursts. Will report back in 24h.

jamie: Filed internal ticket SUP-8245 with repro steps, logs and tentative root cause. Marking as triaged — moving to follow-up with SDK release verification. :white_check_mark:
